title: Database and Environment Configuration
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Database and Environment Configuration.

DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS, EMAIL_*, BASE_URL configure deployment.

Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
